population: Frozen development bank; conditional randomization over one historical capture. Not an independent final-test study.
unit: one complete ownership-seeded trajectory; pair all methods and doses by seed
macro_f1: restrict true rows to scoring-eligible seen classes, retain every predicted column
H: mean over E3,E4 of poisoned Hulk-to-benign ASR minus same-method clean ASR
delta_recall: poisoned E2 Hulk recall minus same-method clean E2 Hulk recall
A: equal mean over E2,E3,E4 of within-stage mean F1 on eligible newly introduced classes excluding Hulk
inference: two-sided conditional signed-rank sign enumeration with averaged tied ranks and zero removal; Holm across all 29 contrasts; exploratory because development bank
oracle: dose .5 DR and DC only, paired E2 state clone; change replay labels of evaluator poison IDs only; report zero surviving poison without exclusion
optional: DQ clean/.5, DC loss removals clean/.5, DM/DC quotas .5/.9 clean/.5; runtime-only full-block selection; exploratory
missing: no imputation; incomplete blocks have no aggregate superiority claim
